title: Resetting your 2FA device
body: If your two-factor authentication codes stop arriving, go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Auth and click 'Reset device'. You'll need to verify via your backup email.

title: Understanding API rate limits (429 responses)
body: Free-tier keys are limited to 60 requests per minute. A 429 response includes a Retry-After header indicating how many seconds to wait before retrying.

title: Exporting your data as CSV
body: Go to Dashboard > Export, choose a date range, and select CSV format. Exports over 100k rows are emailed to you as a download link instead of streamed directly.

title: Billing: understanding proration on plan changes
body: Upgrading mid-cycle charges a prorated difference immediately. Downgrading takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle, with no refund for the current one.

title: Configuring the Slack integration
body: Under Integrations > Slack, click Connect and authorize the OAuth prompt. Notifications can be scoped to specific channels in the integration settings.

title: Why did my scheduled export fail?
body: Scheduled exports fail silently if the destination webhook returns a non-2xx response three times in a row. Check Settings > Exports > History for the failure reason.

title: Team member permissions and roles
body: Roles are Owner, Admin, Editor, and Viewer. Only Owners can change billing details or delete the workspace. Admins can manage members but not billing.

title: Investigating intermittent 500 errors on the API
body: Transient 500s are usually caused by upstream database failover, which typically resolves within 30 seconds. If errors persist beyond a few minutes, check the status page.

title: Requesting permanent account deletion
body: Account deletion requests are processed within 30 days per our data retention policy. Data cannot be recovered once a deletion request is confirmed.

title: Webhook signature verification
body: Every webhook payload includes an X-Signature header, an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body using your webhook signing secret. Verify it before trusting payload contents.
